span.p:
Capture proposed intended use, requested value definition,
effective date, service type, preliminary scope, and subject identifiers

div.style: color: rgb(14, 40, 65) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

Intended Use, and Intended User snapshots

span.p:
Search Vehicle master by VIN, chassis number,

Review preliminary request vehicle facts

Set NeedsInformation

span.p:
Set request status to Converted,
record converted Appraisal ID, and write audit event

span.p:
Commit transaction
and make converted request read-only

span.p:

Intended Use, Intended Users, and use restrictions

Place Appraisal on hold or request clarification

Set Appraisal to active Draft
